item.title: 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
## What’s New
- Customizable music-control buttons. Drag actions into your preferred layout. - Added an Audio Source control with current output-device presentation. - Sneak Peek now appears for playback track changes. Timeout configurable; default: 2 seconds. - Onboarding now reopens from the menu bar and uses the notch’s transparent glass style.
## Fixes
- Fixed HUD updates after Accessibility permission is granted. - Fixed release builds that could exit before showing the menu-bar app. - Added required Bluetooth privacy disclosure. - Fixed Sparkle appcast signing key mismatch.
## Release
- Release assets now use the `anotherNotch` name. - Tagged prereleases generate Sparkle appcast entries.
> Note: Sparkle signing keys were rotated. Install this release manually once; older builds may not auto-update.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
# Another Notch v1.0.0
First stable release of Another Notch.
## Highlights - Music live activity with customizable five-button controls. - Playback sneak peek, configurable timeout; defaults to 2 seconds. - Audio Source control opens macOS Sound Settings with output-device icons. - Bluetooth connection indicator. - Calendar, battery, camera, gestures, notch sizing, liquid-glass controls. - File Shelf with drag-and-drop and AirDrop support. - Improved dark-mode settings contrast.
## Install Download `AnotherNotch.dmg`, move the app to `/Applications`.
macOS may require removing quarantine before first launch:
```sh xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/anotherNotch.app ```
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/commits/v1.0.0-beta.1
